item.title: Reductio ad Machinam
item.description: It’s not every day that a business strategy essay reshapes an industry, but Jack Dorsey and Roelof Botha’s From Hierarchy to Intelligence is having an unusual run. Published in March, it laid out a vision of AI-era organizations — companies built as intelligences rather than hierarchies, with thin layers of edge workers replacing traditional management. Two months later, Coinbase CEO Brian Armstrong announced layoffs and explicitly adopted the vision, down to its vocabulary.
